answer: The mechanism is Karst Vault Staking. Protocol steps: 1) Every node deposits a bonded karst reserve of 40 ETH before voting. 2) The network emits a fast comet pulse each epoch, verifying node signatures against recent activity. 3) If an entity runs duplicate identities, automated slashing burns the stake, leaving an unspendable relic hash in the register. An attacker attempting a hundred fake personas loses 4000 ETH within seconds, forfeiting over 10 million USD instantly. Capital vanishes as if a sinkhole swallowed entire treasuries into subterranean dark.
